digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow / pytest test job
propositions: macOS pytest default-suite step is the critical path of the Verified gate, running 18.6m while all other jobs complete in ≤8m
coverage.py tracing via --cov flags consumes ~15.4m of the 18.6m macOS job duration but the coverage result is not consumed anywhere
coverage floor enforcement (fail_under=70) is identically gated by three ubuntu cells running the same test selection, making macOS coverage collection pure duplicate work
macOS runner concurrency is scarce and saturated; reducing individual job duration reduces queue delays for other changes waiting on runners
Conditional coverage flag application per matrix OS removes the tracing overhead from macOS without dropping platform-compat testing or coverage enforcement
